Use expressive hand-drawn ink contours with selective flat color and open paper space. Use muted rose-violet irises with fine concentric rings, visible pupils, and clear highlights. Center the character's head and shoulders within 70-75% of the frame, safe for a circular crop. Show both eyes clearly. No text, watermark, weapons, or copied anime composition.
